answer: Peer attestations form one thread per agent, and any reputation delta earned in an epoch is released only after the horizon passes without a challenge. Each agent stakes a bond locked to a rolling horizon of epochs; sybils must replicate that capital per identity, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand bonds. Duplicate identities collapse because bonded stake and thread history cannot be cloned cheaply, making mass fakery economically irrational. From once0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
